title: Purchase Windows and the Nonpayment Lockout - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans Desk Guidance
content:
A **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** plan is bought during open season (effective 1 January) or within a qualifying-life-event window (effective on the DEERS event date).

## The window rule

The purchase application must be received no later than the qualifying-life-event window days after the qualifying life event recorded in DEERS. The window is the number of calendar days the tier lists as its qualifying-life-event window.

- **Clock start:** the event date of the qualifying life event as recorded in DEERS - the life-event record the purchase relies on.
- **Counting:** the window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the DEERS event date, so the last timely day is the event date plus the window days.
- **Boundary:** an application received on that last day is timely; one received on the next day is not.
- **Authority:** the caller's own account of a life change never stands in for the DEERS record.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, a window of 90 days)

| DEERS event date | Application received | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2026 | 9 April 2026 | timely |
| 10 January 2026 | 10 April 2026 (event date plus 90 days) | timely - the last timely day |
| 10 January 2026 | 11 April 2026 | not timely |
| none recorded in DEERS (the caller reports a marriage) | any date | no qualifying life event to count from |

## The nonpayment lockout

A purchase is rejected while a nonpayment lockout of the tier's lockout months after nonpayment is still running, counted from the day after the termination date of the plan terminated for nonpayment. A purchaser-requested termination starts no lockout.

| Earlier plan of the purchaser | Lockout |
|---|---|
| terminated for nonpayment, termination date 31 March 2026 (hypothetical) | runs for the lockout months counted from 1 April 2026; a purchase while it runs is rejected |
| terminated at the purchaser's request | none |

A rejected purchase does not start coverage.
